problemStatement.formal: RH := ∀ s : ℂ, riemannZeta s = 0 ∧ 0 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1 → s.re = 1/2. The same proposition is already defined twice in the gallery — in proofs/Proofs/RiemannHypothesis.lean (def RiemannHypothesis, line 128, via isNonTrivialZero) and in proofs/Proofs/PrimeNumberTheoremOQ01.lean (def RiemannHypothesis, line 69) — but no theorem currently bridges them.
problemStatement.plain: Riemann Hypothesis (Millennium Prize, 2000): every non-trivial zero of the Riemann zeta function ζ(s) lies on the critical line Re(s) = 1/2. This slug was seeker-extracted from the parent prime-number-theorem-oq-01 and largely duplicates the existing 'riemann-hypothesis' gallery slug (status COMPLETED, 41 axioms in proofs/Proofs/RiemannHypothesis.lean). Any meaningful S(N) work on this slug must target a narrow tractable adjacent result, NOT the open conjecture itself.
whyMatters: Cleaning the gallery: this slug currently has no formal statement and a NEW-phase state. Either close as duplicate of 'riemann-hypothesis' or reorient onto a small adjacent target. This S1 makes that decision explicit and recommends a bridge theorem as the next iteration.

Bridge value: the two RiemannHypothesis : Prop declarations in RiemannHypothesis.lean and PrimeNumberTheoremOQ01.lean are propositionally identical but not currently linked. A ~30-LOC bridge theorem would let downstream files cite either form.
Axiom-discharge candidates: several axioms in RiemannHypothesis.lean (notably zeta_conj at line 779) may now be discharge-able with current Mathlib via Schwarz reflection / AnalyticOnNhd machinery.

proven: ζ has no zeros for Re(s) > 1 (Mathlib: riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re).
Functional equation ζ(s) ↔ ζ(1-s) via completedRiemannZeta_one_sub.
PNT itself (Hadamard / de la Vallée-Poussin 1896) — formalised in Proofs/PrimeNumberTheorem.lean as PrimeNumberTheorem_Ratio / _Equiv / _Error / _Li with the analytic core axiomatised.
Hardy 1914 (infinitely many zeros on the critical line) — axiomatised in RiemannHypothesis.lean as hardy_infinitely_many_on_critical_line.
Robin (1984), Mertens-Littlewood (1912), von Koch (1901) equivalent reformulations — axiomatised as RH_iff_Robin / RH_iff_Mertens / RH_iff_PrimeCounting in RiemannHypothesis.lean.
open: RH itself — open since 1859; Millennium Prize Problem since 2000. Not tractable in any formalisation session.
Easier direction of RH ↔ Mertens (RH → M(x) = O(x^{1/2+ε})) — blocked on Mathlib lacking the Riemann-von Mangoldt explicit formula for ψ(x).
Easier direction of RH ↔ von Koch / prime counting — same Mathlib gap.
Robin's equivalence (RH ↔ σ(n) < e^γ·n·log log n for n > 5040) — blocked on Mathlib lacking colossally-abundant-number / Gronwall infrastructure.

insights: Seeker-extracted 'Is X true?' sub-OQs for Millennium / Hilbert problems duplicate the parent slug when the parent is already fully developed. This pattern likely affects more than just this slug; the right S1 response is duplicate-detection plus reorientation onto a narrow adjacent target.

The two RiemannHypothesis : Prop declarations in the gallery (RiemannHypothesis.lean uses isNonTrivialZero; PrimeNumberTheoremOQ01.lean uses the unrolled four-argument form) are propositionally identical but not currently linked by a theorem — mild technical debt that a single bridge theorem resolves.

The opaque RiemannHypothesis_statement : Prop token in PrimeNumberTheorem.lean is intentionally NOT equal to either richer RiemannHypothesis definition — that file does not import RiemannZeta machinery and treats RH purely as an opaque hypothesis for conditional PNT-error statements.

Mathlib v4.26.0 has riemannZeta + completedRiemannZeta + Euler-product non-vanishing on Re(s) > 1 + functional equation, but lacks the Riemann-von Mangoldt explicit formula for ψ(x); this gap blocks any 'easy direction' attempt on RH ↔ Mertens / RH ↔ prime counting.

zeta_conj (riemannZeta (conj s) = conj (riemannZeta s)) is currently axiomatised but the Mathlib building blocks for a Schwarz-reflection proof are present (differentiableAt_riemannZeta off the singular set + AnalyticOnNhd.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq + Dirichlet-series agreement on Re(s) > 1). This makes (B) a legitimate medium-difficulty S2 alternate.
mathlibGaps: No formal Riemann-von Mangoldt explicit formula ψ(x) = x − ∑_ρ x^ρ/ρ + ... (blocks RH ↔ Mertens, RH ↔ prime counting easy directions).
No formal Mertens-function bound infrastructure beyond ArithmeticFunction.moebius (blocks Mertens-conjecture-style reformulations).
No formal logarithmic integral Li(x) as a Mathlib primitive (defined locally in PrimeNumberTheoremOQ01.lean as a placeholder).
No formal Robin-class / colossally-abundant-number / Gronwall API (blocks RH ↔ Robin discharge).
No formal Riemann–Siegel formula or Backlund / Hardy–Littlewood zero-counting bounds.
nextSteps: S2 ACT (A — recommended): add Proofs/PrimeNumberTheoremOQ01OQ01.lean with one bridge theorem PrimeNumberTheoremOQ01.RiemannHypothesis ↔ Proofs.RiemannHypothesis.RiemannHypothesis. ~30 LOC, 0 axioms, 0 sorries; unfolds isNonTrivialZero and applies And.intro / And.elim.

Deferred: discharge of any RH_iff_* equivalence (blocked behind Mathlib explicit-formula / Mertens / Robin gaps).
